title: Add caching in front of a slow repository without touching Directory
task: Repeated `EmailOf` calls for the same ID hit the slow repository every time. Add caching so that, within one Directory, a repeated lookup of the same ID never reaches the repository twice; a miss (`ErrNotFound`) must not be cached. Directory's logic should not change; if anything changes it is the wiring. Tests should show the repository is called once for two lookups.
